summary: Iteration 38 - Strategy Sharing features testing complete. All 41 backend tests passed. Frontend ShareViewPage and StrategyDetailPage working correctly with all sharing features.
passed_tests: GET /api/v1/s/{share_id} returns 200 for valid share
Share response has all required fields (success, share_id, strategy, view_count, clone_count, created_at)
Share response excludes user_id for privacy
Share response includes backtest results with metrics and equity_curve
View count increments on each view
Non-existent share returns 404
GET /api/v1/s/{share_id}/copy-text returns 200
Copy-text response has 'text' field with formatted strategy info
Copy-text contains STRATEGY: and Text2trade branding
Non-existent share copy-text returns 404
GET /api/v1/s/{share_id}/pdf returns PDF with application/pdf content-type
PDF has Content-Disposition header with attachment and .pdf filename
Non-existent share PDF returns 404
GET /api/v1/s/{share_id}/broker-instructions/{broker} returns 200 for all 6 brokers (zerodha, angel_one, upstox, dhan, groww, 5paisa)
Broker instructions has required fields (broker, broker_name, symbol, steps, note, help_url)
Invalid broker returns 400
Non-existent share broker instructions returns 404
POST /api/v1/strategies/{id}/share creates share with 8-char ID
Creating share for already shared strategy returns existing share_id with already_shared=true
Create share requires authentication (401/403)
Create share for non-existent strategy returns 404
POST /api/v1/s/{share_id}/clone requires authentication (401/403)
Clone creates new strategy with '(cloned)' in name
Clone non-existent share returns 404
DELETE /api/v1/strategies/{id}/share/{share_id} requires authentication (401/403)
Revoke non-existent share returns 404
GET /api/v1/strategies/{id}/copy-text requires authentication (401/403)
Authenticated copy-text returns formatted text
GET /api/v1/strategies/{id}/pdf requires authentication (401)
PDF with token query param works
GET /api/v1/strategies/{id}/broker-instructions/{broker} requires authentication (401/403)
Authenticated broker instructions returns steps
GET /api/v1/strategies/{id}/share-stats requires authentication (401/403)
Share stats returns view/clone counts and active shares
GET /api/v1/admin/analytics/shares requires admin role (403 for non-admin)
Admin analytics returns total_shares, total_views, total_clones, conversion_rate, top_shared
ShareViewPage loads with strategy name, backtest results, equity curve
ShareViewPage shows broker section with 6 broker buttons
ShareViewPage shows limitations banner
ShareViewPage shows signup CTA for unauthenticated users
ShareViewPage broker instructions appear on button click
StrategyDetailPage shows Share & Export section
StrategyDetailPage shows Copy as Text, Download PDF, Generate Share Link buttons
StrategyDetailPage shows share stats (views, clones, active shares)
StrategyDetailPage shows HOW TO EXECUTE section with 6 broker buttons
StrategyDetailPage broker instructions appear on button click
StrategyDetailPage share link banner appears after generating share
